topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic, contextualizing complement within immunology and setting expectations for the session.

topics.label: Fundamentals and core principles of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational concepts, terminology, and central role of C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three distinct upstream pathways that detect pathogens and converge to trigger C3 activation.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the primary downstream effector outcomes through which activated complement coordinates pathogen elimination.

topics.label: Regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory mechanisms and proteins that protect host cells from accidental complement-mediated damage.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how deficiencies in specific complement components produce distinct infection vulnerabilities and autoimmune-like conditions.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the strategies evolved by pathogens to resist complement activation, focusing on Staphylococcus aureus.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides closing framing, marking the end of the topic and previewing the subsequent lecture.
